From all directions, the loved ones of God have testified to their detachment, their godliness, their humility, and their teaching of the Cause of God, the Lord of what was and what shall be.

At this moment We have taken a cup from the Kawthar of utterance and have drunk in their names. Give them the glad-tidings of this great bounty and this supreme gift.

Jinab-i-Andalib, who hath arisen to serve Me and who circleth around My Cause, upon him be My glory and My mercy, hath made mention of them. Blessed are they both and blessed is he who mentioneth them. Verily, he is among those who are near unto God in My perspicuous Book. The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My grace be upon thee and upon those who are with thee and who love thee for the sake of God, the Lord of the mighty throne. Praise be to God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH06882: O Na'im! Upon thee be the Glory of God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful

O Na'im! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of all worlds. We have mentioned thee before and do so at this time, and We beseech God, exalted be He, to preserve thee and to exalt thee among His servants through His Name, the Protector of all names. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

Say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I have recognized Thy oneness and Thy singleness. I beseech Thee by the pearls of Thy knowledge and the mysteries of Thy Book to make me among those whom nothing whatsoever hath deterred from turning toward Thy most exalted horizon. O Lord! Thou seest the poor one hath sought the ocean of Thy riches, and the oppressed one the horizon of Thy justice. I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause whereby earth and heaven were illumined to ordain for me the good of this world and the world to come. O Lord! Unto Thee be praise for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and adorned my temple with the ornament of Thy love. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of what lieth with Thee, and to ordain for me and for my son and for those with me that which befitteth the ocean of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy generosity. Thou art, verily, the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth through Thy word "Be" and it is.

## BH06504: Jinab-i-Mirza Muhammad arrived and mentioned the ascension… {.unnumbered}

He is the Beloved!

Jinab-i-Mirza Muhammad arrived and mentioned the ascension of the spiritual dove from the earthly ash-heap to the divine Ridvan. The utmost grief, sorrow and anguish appeared. However, since she hastened from the mortal furnace to the life-giving expanse of the immortal rose garden, and ascended from the dark hiding place to the shelter of divine favor, and flew from the earthly ash-heap to the original divine homeland, and reached from the place of limitation to the placeless realm of oneness, therefore you must cleanse and purify the tablet of your heart from grief and sorrow, and hold fast to the firm handle of the hidden divine favors. God willing, you will be nurtured under the shadow of divine generosity and drink from the cup of the hidden mercy of the Infinite Lord. And peace be upon you.

And after Jinab-i-Mirza Muhammad gave a detailed account, whatever they had arranged during their lifetime to send in this direction, send it, and carry out their affairs according to the will they made. Details will be sent upon Mirza Muhammad's return.

## BH06842: O Shaykh! Set aside the cup and take hold… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing Speaker.

O Shaykh! Set aside the cup and take hold of the ocean in His name, the Mighty, the Ever-Flowing. Then drink therefrom, despite every denier who hath denied the Revelation of God and His sovereignty, and every oppressor who hath disbelieved in God, the Lord of all mankind. We have come to educate the servants and improve the lands. To this beareth witness He with Whom is the Mother of Tablets. Not an atom escapeth His knowledge. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Almighty, the Mighty, the Ever-Forgiving. Blessed art thou for having attained unto My days and drunk the choice wine of My love from the hand of My bounty, and believed in Me on a day when every heedless doubter disbelieved.

Say: O people! Behold the Tree and its fruits. They are before your faces. Fear God, O followers of error! Say: Cast aside your idle fancies. By God! The Sun of Certitude hath shone forth from the horizon of God's Will, the Dawning-Place of Lights. Thus hath the Most Great Announcement revealed His verses as a grace from His presence, and He is the Mighty, the All-Forgiving. The light and its radiance, and the sun and its effulgence be upon thee and upon those who have arisen and said: "The Kingdom is God's, the Lord of Lords!"

## BH06763: The breeze of supreme mercy has risen… {.unnumbered}

The breeze of supreme mercy has risen from the holy Paradise of eternity, and the northern wind of highest favor has been stirred from the eternal Ridvan of the spirit....

O spirit! O spirit! May this morning be the true dawn, and may this herald be calling from the Joseph of divine beauty! Although there exists no heart like Jacob's—pure, spotless and holy, free from all faults and defects—that might catch the fragrances of the merciful spirit from the holy divine breaths, and rend asunder the garments of body and soul, of possibility and creation, and turn its gaze away from both the realm of limitations and beyond, to become worthy and deserving of the subtleties and delicacies of this wondrous Cause, this exalted Mystery, this glorious Remembrance....

## BH06574: Glory be unto Thee! Glory be unto Thee! O… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of our Most Holy, Most Great, Most Exalted, Most Glorious Lord!

Glory be unto Thee! Glory be unto Thee! O Helper of Thy servants, Master of right guidance, and Guide to the straight path! I beseech Thee by the melodies of the birds of Thy most exalted Paradise, whereby the realities of all things and the hearts of humanity were attracted, and by Thy sovereignty which hath encompassed the kingdom of earth and heaven, and by Thy signs whereby Thou didst subdue the cities of earth and the realm of power, and by Thy Most Great Name through which Thou didst separate between the nations and didst manifest the stations of existence, O Thou Who holdest the reins of bounty, to assist Thy Afnan and Thy chosen ones and Thy loved ones and Thy trusted ones to arise to serve Thee and to act according to that which Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book.

O Lord! Thou seest one of Thy Afnan clinging to the cord of Thy commandments and the handle of Thy bounty. Ordain for him that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones who have turned only to the lights of Thy countenance and who have desired to act according to that which Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book and Thy Tablets. O Lord! Open before his face the door of Thy bounty, then raise him up through Thy Name in Thy lands amongst Thy servants. Verily Thou art the All-Powerful, the All-Bountiful, the Forgiver, the Generous. There is no God but Thee, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

## BH06590: Glorified art Thou, O Thou through Whose Name… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O Thou through Whose Name the Tree hath spoken forth on the Mount of Recognition and the lights of the Sun of Thy countenance have shone from the horizon of creation! I beseech Thee by the Dawning-Places of Thy Most Beautiful Names and the Daysprings of Thy Most Exalted Attributes and by Thy Greatest Signs, to send down upon Thy servants that which will draw them to the Most Exalted Horizon and bring them nigh unto Thee, O Lord of all beings and King of the throne on high and of the dust below. O my Lord! The souls have been encompassed by the veils of idle fancies and these have prevented them from turning toward the horizon of certitude.

I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, by Thy Name the Self-Subsisting, to aid Thy loved ones to stand firm in Thy Cause and to write down for them from Thy Most Exalted Pen that which shall profit them in every world of Thy worlds.

O my Lord! Disappoint them not of what lieth with Thee, and withhold not from them that which Thou hast ordained for such of Thy servants as are nigh unto Thee and such of Thy creatures as are sincere before Thee. O my Lord! Thou seest them turning toward Thee, and facing the lights of Thy countenance, and hastening toward the ocean of Thy bounty. Do Thou provide them, O my God, with the heavenly table Thou hast sent down from the heaven of Thy grace, and with the blessing Thou hast ordained in Thy Scrolls and Books and Tablets. There is no God but Thee, the Mighty, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH06680: Say: I bear witness, O my God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Hearer, the Answerer!

Say: I bear witness, O my God, to that which Thy Prophets and Thy Chosen Ones have witnessed, and to that which Thou hast revealed in Thy Books and Thy Scriptures. I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Book and by Him through Whom Thou didst unlock the gates of knowledge to Thy creation and didst raise the banner of unity among Thy servants, that Thou grant me the intercession of the Lord of the Messengers and Guide of the Ways, and enable me to do that which Thou lovest and approvest.

O Lord! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I am assured of Thy oneness and singleness, and hold fast to the cord of Thy loving-kindness and bounty. I beseech Thee, O Possessor of the Kingdom and Ruler over the Realm of Might, by Thy Name through which Thou didst subdue both kings and subjects, to ordain for me that which shall profit me. Verily, Thou knowest what is with me and I know not what is with Thee. Thou art indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

O Lord! Praise be to Thee for having shown me the ocean of Thy utterance and the heaven of Thy bounty. I call upon Thee, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of all religions, to assist me to remember Thee and praise Thee and to act in accordance with that which Thou hast revealed in Thy Book. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Exalted, the Mighty, the Loving.

## BH06690: Say: Glory be to Thee, O Thou through Whose… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Seeing, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise

Say: Glory be to Thee, O Thou through Whose Name the gate of divine knowledge hath been opened before all who are in heaven and on earth, and through Whose Will the verses of wisdom and utterance have been sent down. I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy knowledge and the heaven of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy grace to ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of this world and of the world to come. Cause me, then, O my God, to be attracted by Thy verses, to be turned toward the lights of Thy countenance, to speak forth Thy praise, to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book, and to remain steadfast in the Cause at whose appearance all who are in the heavens and on earth were thunderstruck, save those whom the hand of Thy power and Thy will did rescue.

O Lord! Thou seest me turning toward Thee, hoping for the wondrous gifts of Thy grace which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones. Thou art He Whom the affairs of the world cannot frustrate, nor can the veils of the nations prevent Thee. Through Thy sovereignty Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having caused me to hear Thy call and revealed through Thy bounty that of which I was heedless, and made me turn toward the horizon from which Thy servants and creatures have turned away. I beseech Thee to assist me in serving Thee. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Munificent, the Forgiving, the Gracious.

## BH06694: Say: O concourse of princes and divines! Know… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise

Say: O concourse of princes and divines! Know of a certainty that ye cannot frustrate God. He, in truth, doth now announce unto you a manifest chastisement. My Pen of Command hath lamented, My heart hath groaned, Mine eyes have wept tears, and My liver hath melted by reason of what hath befallen Me at the hands of the rebellious among My servants, after I came unto them from the dawning-place of destiny with a light that illumined the horizons. He who hath transgressed and rebelled against Me shall not endure upon the face of the earth. Nay, by the Lord of all beings! He shall soon find himself in manifest loss.

Say: The Wronged One calleth you unto that which profiteth you, and seeketh no recompense from you. Fear ye God, O people, then judge fairly in a Cause at whose appearance the verses bowed down in submission. Thus hath the ocean of utterance surged when the Pen of the All-Merciful was set in motion in this exalted station. When thine eyes are gladdened by witnessing that which hath shone forth from the horizon of the Tablet, render thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous. The splendor shining from the horizon of the heaven of My grace be upon thee and upon whomsoever hath loved thee for the sake of God, the Most High, the Most Great. Praise be unto Him Who is the Goal of all that are in the heavens and on earth.

## BH06897: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH11652: O my God, my Adored One, my Beloved, my… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Luminous, the All-Glorious, the Most Glorious!

O my God, my Adored One, my Beloved, my Heart's Desire! With what countenance shall I turn to Thy most glorious Kingdom, and with what tongue shall I implore Thy forgiveness and pardon? Not once did I draw a breath purely for Thy sake, freed from this cage of self, nor did I take a single step save in pursuit of my own desires. O my God, so immersed am I in transgression that I am ashamed of the very act of transgression itself, let alone standing before Thy most holy presence. How can I render thanks for Thy perpetual and abundant blessings and favors? Thou didst bring me forth from utter and absolute nothingness into the realm of being and existence, and honored me with the glory of beholding Thy presence—the highest aspiration of all Thy Prophets and chosen ones. I grew heedless of Thy remembrance, yet Thou didst not forget me; I disobeyed Thee, yet Thou didst not withhold from me Thy all-encompassing mercy.

O my God, in this moment and at this hour, my hand is cut short of all recourse. I beseech and implore Thy forgiveness. I ask Thee, by the sanctity of Thy verses and Thy signs, to forgive me and my father and my mother. Verily, Thou art the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. There is no God but Thee, the Compassionate, the Bountiful.

## BH11654: O Hasan! These days are the days… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Exalted, Most Beauteous, Most Holy, Most High!

O Hasan! These days are the days of the greatest tests and mightiest trials. Hold fast to the cord of divine favour and cling to the hem of mercy. Purify and sanctify thy heart from the dark and shadowy forms of this world and enter into the sanctified realm of Divine Unity. Know all save Him to be non-existent and count all else as void. With pure vision gaze upon the Most Great Horizon. Today all eyes are veiled and all vision is barred, save those souls who, through divine favour and the wondrous tokens of heavenly grace, have rent asunder the veils and entered the pavilion of the King of Names and Attributes.

Say: O servants of God! Without Him, none hath been or shall ever be known. Rather, all else is known through Him. Whosoever turneth away from His Cause is accounted before God as one of the people of fire and of the lowest depths, though he be among the most eminent of his time. And whosoever attaineth unto His recognition is reckoned among the denizens of the most exalted Paradise and the most glorious Ridvan, though he be among the lowliest of creation. Such is God's bounty and His mercy unto His loved ones. And the glory be upon thee!

## BH11655: The Most Holy, the Most Great {.unnumbered}

The Most Holy, the Most Great.

A mention from Us to him who hath been mentioned before the Throne and hath attained unto the lights of this Dayspring which hath appeared in human form. Exalted is the Self-Subsisting One through Whose Name the idols of idle fancy have been shattered and the Tongue of Grandeur hath spoken: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Verily, We make mention of him who hath turned unto God that the warmth of His love may be kindled in his heart in such wise that the opposition of the opposers shall not quench it, and that he may aid his Lord through the swords of wisdom and utterance. He, verily, is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

The servants have been forbidden to engage in conflict and contention, and have been commanded to show forth kindliness in this Most Wondrous, Most Holy, Most Mighty, Most Praiseworthy Revelation. He who hath attained unto that which hath been commanded, verily, is of the people of My Kingdom. He Who summoneth all unto God, the Single One, the All-Informed, beareth witness unto this.

When thou art stirred by the breezes of thy Lord's love through this Tablet, arise to mention Him with gracious remembrance amongst the servants. This, verily, is the most excellent of deeds and the essence thereof. Well is it with them that comprehend.

May the glory rest upon thee and upon him who hath turned unto God whilst every denier, remote from Him, hath turned away.

## BH07361: O Ba'i, upon thee be My glory! Last night… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory—Wisdom and Utterance

O Ba'i, upon thee be My glory! Last night Jinab-i-Asad, upon him be My glory, acting as thy representative, was engaged in offering hospitality. A number of the friends—travelers, emigrants and pilgrims—were present. Praise be to God, after attaining His presence and hearkening to His call, they were blessed with divine bounty and rendered thanks to God, exalted be His glory. Blessed are they who in these days are occupied in service. One deed performed in God's path during these days is dearer and more excellent than the deeds of centuries and ages past. We testify that thou hast succeeded in serving the Wronged One and hast quaffed the choice wine of utterance from the cup of thy Lord's bestowal, the All-Merciful.

In brief, at the feast gathering, various bounties and blessings including sweets and other things were present and visible, and Jinab-i-Asad carried out his representation with the utmost joy and fragrance. Blessed art thou, and blessed is he, and blessed are they who have attained to the bounty of God, the Lord of all worlds. The Glory be upon thee and upon God's sincere servants.

## BH06951: O Most Exalted Pen! Make mention of him who… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Seeing, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

O Most Exalted Pen! Make mention of him who hath turned unto thee, and hath voiced thy praise, and hath arisen to serve thee amongst thy servants, that he may rejoice and be of them that are thankful. We have sent unto thee aforetime that which no mention in the world can equal, as beareth witness He Who speaketh that there is no God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The clamor of the ungodly hath been raised, and their uproar, and they desire to spread corruption in the land after it hath been set in order. Thus doth inform thee He with Whom is the perspicuous Book. We beseech God to assist thee and aid thee to serve His Cause in such wise that the hosts of the world and the clamor of them that cry out shall not deter thee.

We have made mention of thee in numerous Tablets. Thy Lord is verily the Compassionate, the Bountiful. Preserve this most exalted station through the Name of thy Lord, the Lord of all beings, and be thou of them that are steadfast. The splendor that hath shone forth from the heaven of the mercy of thy Lord be upon thee and upon them that have quaffed the choice wine of revelation from the hand of the bounty of their Lord, the Gracious.

## BH07028: We have made mention of his honor Mahmud, upon… {.unnumbered}

We have made mention of his honor Mahmud, upon him be the glory of God, from the people of Nun and Ra. We beseech God to protect him and to ordain for him whatsoever he desires from the bounty of his Lord, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

O Mahmud! We have heard thy communion with God and have answered thee through this clear utterance. And We make mention of ʿAta'u'llah and give him the glad-tidings of My loving-kindness and mercy, and remind him of My verses, for I am the All-Knowing Remembrancer. And We make mention of Ibn-i-Kamal who attained My presence and circled round Me and held fast to the cord of My loving-kindness and clung to My robe. We beseech God to send down upon him from the heaven of His bounty that which befitteth His grace and generosity, for verily He is the Munificent, the Most Generous.

O Mahmud! Upon thee be My glory! We have mentioned thee before and at this hour—give thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Forgiving, the Most Generous. Glory be upon thee and upon thy wife who turned towards God on a day wherein every perfidious wretch and every dubious learned one turned away.

## BH07340: O my handmaiden! Your letter was received and attained… {.unnumbered}

He is the Hearing and the Answering

O my handmaiden! Your letter was received and attained the honor of being heard by the Wronged One. Today all are beheld on one plane. Whosoever has turned and faced [Him] with radiant countenance, pure heart and sanctified breast—such a one is recorded among the people of Baha and inscribed by the Supreme Pen in the Crimson Book. The deeds of centuries and ages do not equal this act in this Day. How excellent is the state of one who has aided God, exalted be His glory, through goodly deeds and praiseworthy conduct. How many men are seen deprived today, and how many handmaidens have raised their tents on the shores of the ocean of recognition. Convey My greetings to thy daughters and remind them of My remembrance and loving-kindness and verses. We beseech God, exalted be He, to forgive thee and them. Verily He is the All-Bountiful, the Generous. And He is the Compassionate, the All-Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH06907: Praise be to God that through the wondrous favors… {.unnumbered}

In the name of the One True God!

Praise be to God that through the wondrous favors of God thou hast arrived at the shore of the Most Great Ocean and been sustained by the holy heavenly food which is the utterance of Truth. Although this station is veiled due to the lack of capacity in this time, yet this veil shall be lifted and will become manifest in the assemblage of the world.

Blessed art thou for having attained the presence of the Beloved and for having turned to Him by His leave and heard His mighty and wondrous call. What hath been recorded in this Tablet sufficeth thee and nothing that can be comprehended equalleth it.

Be thankful and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of Lords and Merciful One to the servants, for having strengthened me and enabled me and honored me with Thy presence. I beseech Thee not to leave me to myself, then make me among those who soar in the atmosphere of Thy love with the wings of certitude. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

## BH07012: After your book was presented in the Most Holy… {.unnumbered}

After your book was presented in the Most Holy Court—that is, that very letter in its entirety was presented before His Countenance—the utmost favor shone forth and dawned from the horizon of the bounties of the Desired One. This servant must praise and thank God, exalted be His glory, a hundred thousand times that you have drunk from the wine of divine knowledge, from which most people today are deprived, and have turned toward the horizon of the Manifestation. Praise be to God that you are among the people of light and have attained to its horizon, dawning-place and source. We hope that at all times you will drink and cause others to drink from the pure water of the Kawthar of the love of the All-Merciful. According to His command that you not be saddened by separation: What is necessary today is to teach the Cause with the wisdom with which all are commanded. God willing, may you attain to this most great bounty and become the cup-bearer of the most pure wine. Verily, He writes for whomsoever He wishes the reward of attainment unto His presence. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Supreme, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH07284: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH07429: O Nasru'llah! Thou hast attained unto the Word… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the One True God!

O Nasru'llah! Thou hast attained unto the Word of God, with which nothing in all creation can compare. Know this and be thou of the thankful ones. The Most Exalted Pen enjoineth steadfastness upon the people of God, inasmuch as clamors have been raised from every quarter. Those who in the days of hardship remained hidden behind veils like unto women have now, like unto serpents, risen up against the Lord of Names. They have turned away from that Station which hath been sent down from the heaven of His Will—a Station that equalleth all the books of the past and the future—and are striving with their vain imaginings to lead the servants astray. Fie upon them and upon that which their hands have wrought in their rebellion against God, their opposition to Him, their turning away from Him, and their rejection of that which hath been sent down from the kingdom of His wondrous utterance.

Convey My greetings to the friends and gladden them with the bounties of their Lord, exalted be His glory. The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My favor be upon thee and upon all who are steadfast and firm.

## BH07127: Glorified art Thou, O Lord of humanity and Master… {.unnumbered}

He is God, blessed and exalted be His station!

Glorified art Thou, O Lord of humanity and Master of the mysteries of destiny! All atoms testify to Thy grace and loving-kindness, and all created things acknowledge Thy gifts and tender mercy. I beseech Thee, by that wherewith Thou hast described Thyself through Thy most excellent names and most exalted attributes, to grant unto him whom Thou hast related to the branches of the Tree of Thy Cause, and brought forth from the loins of one whom Thou didst single out for Thy service, Thy love, Thy grace and Thy tender mercy, every good thing which Thou hast ordained in Thy Book.

O my Lord! Enable him to ascend unto the heights of knowledge at all times and to attain unto that which Thou hast promised unto Thy sincere ones, O my Lord, the Most Merciful. Aid him to serve his father in such wise as not to depart from his good-pleasure, and preserve him, O my Creator, beneath the shade of the Tree of Thy protection and shelter. Honor him with the robes of Thy bounty and loving-kindness, for Thou art He Who hath been called by Thy name, the All-Bountiful, by the tongues of all peoples. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Generous, the All-Giving, the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

## BH07044: At all times must man pass beyond all created… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

At all times must man pass beyond all created things and, turning his gaze toward God, his gracious Lord, hasten to the dwelling-place of the Beloved. O ʿAli! If thou askest of Our condition: having not yet been delivered from the prison of Our enemies, We have entered into the prison of Our friends, and having not yet escaped from the bonds of Our foes, We have become caught in the bonds of Our loved ones. Such is Our condition.

O ʿAli! The world hath no permanence, but religion hath no end. Therefore, thou must never sell religion for the world, that thou mayest soar on the wings of might and power toward the heaven of the All-Merciful at the time when it was raised up and spread forth in truth.

O ʿAli! Until the heart is sanctified from vain imaginings, it will not journey toward the beauty of the All-Knowing Lord, and until the soul passeth beyond all contingent things, it will not hasten to the dwelling-place of the Beloved. Be thou among those who act accordingly.

And the Spirit be upon those who follow guidance in these pure and luminous days. The household members, both the mother and others, convey their most exalted and wondrous greetings.

## BH07267: By My life! Such wrongs have been inflicted upon… {.unnumbered}

By My life! Such wrongs have been inflicted upon this Revelation as have no parallel or likeness in the past or present. Convey My greetings to the loved ones of that land on behalf of this Wronged One and say: The thieves and deceivers lie in ambush, and from Kaf and Ra arise howlings as they busy themselves with godlessness. They have collected many sublime and glorious verses...

Indeed they have manifested such deceit as hath never been heard of before. Now with the utmost craftiness and guile they profess love to each of the friends of God while subtly mentioning certain matters that perchance may hold back the people of God from the Most Exalted Horizon. Their honey concealeth poison, and their protestations of love mask hidden hatred...

In brief, they send forth strange and wondrous writings, publishing certain wondrous verses either in their own name or in the name of the Point of the Bayan—may the souls of all else be sacrificed for His sake—or in other names.

## BH07092: Sin, Mim: We have sent down the Book unto… {.unnumbered}

He is the Sovereign Protector over all that is on earth and in heaven.

Sin, Mim: We have sent down the Book unto thee and dispatched it to thee as a bounty from God, the Lord of the worlds. That which thou didst send hath been mentioned before the Wronged One, and We have answered thee with this wondrous Tablet.

What Ibn-i-Abhar (upon him be My glory and loving-kindness) sent was read, and We have mentioned those whom he named in his letter—Sad, Kaf, Qaf, Mim, Qaf and Ta—as he was traveling through the lands with a remembrance that no other remembrance can equal, as attesteth He Who possesseth a preserved Book. We mentioned him before; give him the glad-tidings of thy Lord's loving-kindness that he may rejoice and be among the thankful ones. Some time ago We graciously answered his petitions in the letter of the servant who was present, but there was a delay in sending it. God willing, both the first and second will be sent according to the requirements of the time. Verily thy Lord is the Gladdener, the All-Knowing.

The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon thee and upon those with thee.

## BH11657: Praise be to God Who has shattered the idols… {.unnumbered}

Praise be to God Who has shattered the idols of vain imaginings through His Self-Subsisting Name...

Haji Muhammad Karim Khan Kirmani wrote a book every year refuting the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—and likewise Sipihr in his history attributed things to His Holiness that caused every person of insight to weep blood and every informed one to lament. We complain of our grief and sorrow to God. In any case, they burned with the fire of greed and passion and are not aware, and the flame of covetousness has seized them to such a degree that pen and ink are powerless and fall short of describing it.

My God, my God! Thou hearest their calumnies and seest what hath befallen Thy loved ones at the hands of the oppressors among Thy creation and the transgressors among Thy servants. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy power to aid those who have kindled the fire of injustice in Thy lands and domains and spread their own calumnies to undermine Thy Cause, that they may return unto Thee and confess what they have wrought in Thy days. Verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Merciful....

## BH07000: Concerning the matters you mentioned—we beseech God… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He!

Concerning the matters you mentioned—we beseech God to open before your face the gates of blessing and bounty, verily He is powerful over all things. His hidden grace has been with you and outwardly too it will encompass you. Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having made me to know Thee and taught me and guided me to Thy straight path and Thy News at which the hearts of the ungodly and transgressors were troubled. I beseech Thee, O Cleaver of the Dawn, by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and by the mysteries hidden in Thy knowledge and the penetration of Thy Command and the power of Thy Pen, to ordain for me what is best in this world and the next.

By Thy might, O God of the world and Goal of the nations, I have desired naught but the exaltation of Thy Word and the manifestation of Thy Cause. I beseech Thee by Thy greatness and sovereignty to assist me through the means of the heavens and earth that I may be occupied at all times in Thy service and speaking in Thy remembrance. Then protect me, O my God, by the hosts of Thy power. Verily Thou art powerful over what Thou willest and verily Thou art the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH07027: Unto Jinab-i-Badi'u'llah—upon him be the glory of God—we convey… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding.

Unto Jinab-i-Badi'u'llah—upon him be the glory of God—we convey greetings and offer our salutations. Thy list, in very truth, was a white and radiant scroll, for naught proceedeth from good save that which is good. God willing, may the portals of beneficence be opened unto thy face from every direction by the command of the Lord of Names and Attributes.

We make mention of Varaqih-i-Furughiyyih—upon her be most glorious glory. The desire of the Exalted Leaf, Mahd-i-ʿUlya, hath attained acceptance. We beseech God that, through His bounty, He may gather us all together. Verily, He is the Generous, the Bountiful.

To all the members of the household I convey greetings. I remember Hayatiyyih and Lami'ih, and those with them, in a noble remembrance. Unto the Leaf—that is, the Afnan—we send our salutations, and from the True One We ask for her that which shall be the cause of everlasting renown.

We make mention in abiding remembrances of Maryam Khanum, and of Mirza Musa—upon him be the glory of God—and upon her be the loving-kindness of God. The sister had set out for the Presence; God willing, she hath attained. We also made mention of Varaqih-i-Liqa; likewise of ʿAta'iyyih and the maidservants who are there.

## BH07110: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise!

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the lamp of Thy utterance hath been lit within the niche of Thy knowledge, and the breezes of Thy favors have wafted over the people of Thy dominion, to make me in all conditions steadfast in Thy service and illumined by the lights of Thy knowledge and Thy love in such wise that the doubts of the world shall not withhold me nor the imaginings of the nations prevent me. Then cause me, O my God, to be content with whatsoever Thou hast ordained for me through Thy grace and bounty and generosity and favors. O Lord! Leave me not to myself. Gladden me in all times and circumstances with the glad-tidings that were specially reserved for Thy days. Verily, Thou art the Almighty over what Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting.

Thy letter hath come and We have read it and answered thee with that wherewith God, the Lord of the worlds, is called upon and invoked in Thy days. He, verily, is the Commander, the All-Informed. Glory be unto those who have cast away all else, turning toward God, the Fashioner of the heavens. They are indeed among the well-doers. Praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.

## BH07169: In My Name, the Wronged One {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the Wronged One.

The Day of Return hath come, the Book hath been sent down, and the Throne hath been adorned with the Lord of all mankind; yet the doubter stirreth in the hearts, saying: "This is naught but a wondrous thing!"

O people! The Day hath come, and the Qayyum calleth aloud: "The Kingdom is God's, the Lord of lords!"

O thou who gazest upon the Countenance! Should anyone ask thee of the Ark of God, say: "Verily, it is amidst the waves"—through that which it hath wrought, and by the mystery We raised above the clouds.

The tongue of the mute hath arisen before the Kingdom of utterance and hath spoken that whereat the near ones and the sincere have wailed at eventide and at dawn.

Thus hath there come unto Us from him whom We reared and raised unto the most exalted station. Will any deny that which hath flowed from the Pen? Nay, by My life—save him who casteth justice behind his back, clinging to the oppression and tyranny he possesseth.

I beseech Thee, O Joy of the world, to transmute the sorrows of Thy servants into gladness. Verily, Thou art the All-Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

## BH07171: Prayer for Mirza Yahya {.unnumbered}

We took a handful of dust, breathed into it a spirit from Our presence, and raised it above the heavens. Yet when it beheld itself in the loftiest station, it denied the favour of its Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing; disbelieved in His bounty; disputed His verses; rejected His proof; and committed that whereat the sincere have lamented. Verily we are God's, and unto Him shall we return.

O my God, my God! Thou knowest and Thou seest what hath befallen Me at the hands of one whom We nurtured through many years, and sheltered beneath the pavilion of My loving care and mercy which hath preceded all created things. When he beheld the people turning toward him and humbling themselves before him, he turned away from his Lord and wrought that whereat the dwellers within the pavilion of My love and the tent of My glory have wailed.

O Lord! Transform his turning away, and make him aware of his station and of Thy praise, lest he transgress his bounds. Verily, Thou art the All-Forgiving, the Most Generous.

O Yahya! Fear God, and be not of the wrongdoers. Slay not him who reared thee with the swords of falsehood and slander. Fear God, and be not of the lost.

## BH07192: My Most Exalted Pen hath testified… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Seeing, the All-Witnessing, the All-Knowing

My Most Exalted Pen hath testified to that which the tongue of My grandeur testified before the creation of My heaven and My earth—that there is none other God but Me, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting. Blessed is he who hath recognized Him Who is known and acted according to that which was commanded by God, the Lord of existence. The time for words hath passed and the day for deeds hath come, would that ye knew it. Gone are the days of fancy and vain imaginings, and come is the day of certitude, would that ye understood.

O My loved ones in My lands! Hold ye fast unto the cord of My loving-kindness and cling to the hem of My luminous and blessed robe.

O thou who hast turned toward the Most Exalted Summit! Hearken unto the call of the Wronged One. He remembereth thee purely for the sake of God and biddeth thee to be steadfast in this noble and exalted Cause. Beware lest human conditions prevent thee from Him Who is the Lord of destiny. Leave what the people possess, taking hold of that which hath been sent down from the Kingdom of My grace, which hath encompassed both the unseen and the visible. Thus hath spoken the tongue of the Wronged One in this praiseworthy station. When thou hearest and recognizeth, render thanks unto thy Lord, the Mighty, the Beloved.

## BH07213: Say: O God, Lord of Names and Creator… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting

Say: O God, Lord of Names and Creator of all things! I beseech Thee by Thy all-encompassing mercy and Thy all-pervading favor to assist Thy loved ones to make mention of Thee and to sing Thy praise. Guide through them all servants unto the city of Thy love, and nourish them with the fruits of the Tree of Unity and from the springs of the rivers of detachment, that they may warble upon the branches of the Tree of Certitude with wondrous melodies of divine unity, and sanctify Thee in the realm of similitudes from all comparison and likeness, and exalt Thee in the world of causes above all casual intimations, and call upon Thee with attributes of ancientness and eternity, extolling the essence of Thy Being as sanctified from all accidents, Thy eternity as elevated above all temporal events, and Thy existence as transcending all firstness and lastness, all outwardness and inwardness.

O Lord! Having called them unto Thee, drive them not from Thy door, and having guided them unto the city of Thy Cause, deprive them not of the outpourings of Thy grace and favor. And having admitted them into the pavilion of Thy knowledge, preserve the essence of their love from the promptings of the souls that command to aught else save Thy good-pleasure. Regard not, O my Lord, their powerlessness, but rather look upon the kingdom of Thy power and the dominion of Thy grandeur, for in Thy hands lie the kingdom of grace and bounty. Through Thy loving-kindness, ordain for them that which shall profit them in every world of Thy worlds.

There is none other God but Thee, the Gracious, the Bountiful, the Mighty, the Generous.

## BH07328: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH07414: O Muhammad son of Taqi! This is the Day… {.unnumbered}

O Muhammad son of Taqi! This is the Day whereon the full moon of divine knowledge hath emerged from the veils of utterance, a glad-tiding from the presence of the All-Merciful, that thou mayest give thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Bountiful.

O thou who gazest upon the Countenance! We have adorned thy head with the diadem of loving care and thy frame with the ornament of bounty, that thou mayest hold fast unto the Most Exalted Word "He doeth whatsoever He willeth and ordaineth whatsoever He pleaseth". This Word preserveth thee from the fire of idolatry and giveth thee to drink of the Kawthar of oneness from the hand of the grace of thy Lord, the All-Praised.

This day it behoveth all to look toward the horizon of the Manifestation of unity, and to believe with assurance that the True One doeth whatsoever He willeth. Whoso layeth fast hold upon this blessed Word is preserved from misbelief and from the doubts of the suspicious.

With might supreme hath there been sent down, from the Pen of the Lord of eternity, for the people of the world, a particular and weighty utterance: the blessed verse "Muhammad is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets," together with the blessed verse "The Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds." Therefore hath He Who conversed with Moses upon Sinai been established upon the throne of Revelation, and hath spoken that which He was commanded from the presence of God, the Lord of the mighty Throne.

## BH11658: In My Name which shineth forth from the horizon… {.unnumbered}

In My Name which shineth forth from the horizon of the heaven of utterance!

This is a Book sent down by the Wronged One unto him who hath believed in God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting, and who hath turned his face unto the Countenance after the passing away of all things. Verily, he is among those who have broken the chains of idle fancies, turning unto God, the Lord of what was and what shall be.

O Mas'ud! God hath made thee happy through His bounty, and hath aided thee to turn unto the horizon wherefrom the servants have turned aside, save those whom God, the Lord of the seen and the unseen, hath willed. Thy mention was made before the Throne aforetime, and We make mention of thee as a token of Our grace. Verily thy Lord is the All-Forgiving, the All-Kind. And this is time and again. Be thou thankful unto God, thy Lord, for this manifest bounty. Stand firm in the service of thy Lord, be vocal in His praise, and place thy trust in Him in all matters. Verily, He heareth thy call and seeth thee. He is, in truth, the Mighty, the All-Loving.

The splendor that hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon thee and upon those who have held fast unto the cord of God, the Lord of what was and what shall be.

## BH07983: O Mihdi! Upon thee be the peace and mercy… {.unnumbered}

He is God—exalted be His glory, the Most Great, the All-Powerful

O Mihdi! Upon thee be the peace and mercy of God. These are the days of Ramadan—we fast and remain silent during the day, and arise and speak during the night. Some who claim to love God in various regions are deprived of both deeds and wisdom, but God is the Concealer, the All-Knowing. Many times has this exalted Word been mentioned: "Believe not every speaker, and trust not every newcomer." This Wronged One beseeches God to aid all to act according to His commandments. Verily, He is the Helper, the Mighty, the Powerful....

The matter depends upon the consent of both parties and their parents. In the absence of parents, it depends on the consent of the guardians of both parties. And whatever both parties have covenanted, they must fulfill....

## BH07776: Say: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning… {.unnumbered}

...Say: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward the heaven of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy grace, detached from Thy servants and Thy creation. I am he who, O my God, hath acknowledged that which Thou hast revealed in Thy Books. I testify that Thou art God, there is no God but Thee. Thou hast ever delivered Thy servants through the arm of Thy power from the pit of idle fancies and vain imaginings, and Thou wilt ever save them through Thy sovereignty and protect them from the oppression of men through Thy might and power. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the worlds and Deliverer of the nations, by Thy Name through which was manifested that which was hidden in the eternity of eternities and concealed from the eyes of men, to assist me in all my deeds. By Thy glory! I desire no helper other than Thee, and love no champion save Thee. I beseech Thee by the wonders of Thy grace and the revelations of the Sun of Thy bounty to aid me in that which will elevate my station, my remembrance, and my name. Verily, Thou art the Answerer, and verily, Thou art the All-Knowing. There is no God but Thee, the Mighty, the Great....

## BH07892: O Ism-i-Jud! Upon thee be My glory and My… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory, the Greatness and Power

O Ism-i-Jud! Upon thee be My glory and My peace. The letter of Nabil, son of Nabil, was read before the Wronged One. Praise be to God, it was adorned with steadfastness, attachment, recognition and certitude. We give thanks to God for this and beseech Him to assist him with that which will profit him in this world and the next. Verily, He is the Strong, the Mighty, the Powerful.

Convey greetings from the Wronged One to Abdul-Husayn, upon him be My glory. His letter was noted and attained unto Our hearing. Verily We heard his call from My tongue. We beseech the True One to grant success that he may at all times do that which is the cause of exaltation and elevation. And We remember Ahmad, upon him be My peace, who was with Us. We have remembered him and do remember him, and We beseech God, exalted be He, to protect him with the hosts of the seen and the unseen. Verily He is the Compassionate, the Generous. Praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.

## BH07891: O Ism-i-Jud! Thou didst make mention of him who… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He, the Manifestation of Commands and Laws

O Ism-i-Jud! Thou didst make mention of him who was named Ghulam-Husayn, upon him be My glory. Although the condition of this land is not known, yet permission hath been granted. Give thou the glad-tidings unto Samandar, upon him be My glory, that he may rejoice in this bounty from Our presence. In all circumstances they must observe wisdom. Thus hath God ordained, both before and after, in the Scriptures and Tablets. If wisdom requireth it, let them turn with spirit and fragrance. We beseech God, exalted be He, to assist him in that which beseemeth His days and to aid him in that which He desireth, adorned with that which hath been sent down in the Book. O Samandar! Give thou the glad-tidings that We have mentioned him whom thou didst mention before and after, and We give him the glad-tidings of that which hath shone forth from the Daystar of permission from the horizon of his Lord's will, the Mighty, the Powerful. But in all circumstances they must observe wisdom. Verily, He is the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

## BH07568: In reply to Abdul-Husayn's letter, write: Regarding what was… {.unnumbered}

In reply to Abdul-Husayn's letter, write: Regarding what was mentioned about differences between the friends—all are obligated by the Divine Tablets to demonstrate love, unity, affection and fellowship, which are the cause of exalting the Word of God, and they must act accordingly. We beseech and implore God, exalted be His glory, to enable all the friends to attain to this most exalted station, so that all may arise in unity to serve the Cause.

Mention of you was made in the Most Holy Presence, and you have attained to God's favors. According to His command: those souls who are today associated with the Truth and adorned with the lights of recognition must strive to remove differences, for no harm has been or will be greater than discord between the friends. God willing, you will strive to the extent possible in this matter. God speaks the truth and verily guides to the straight path.

## BH07555: O spiritual bird, praise God that at all times… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious

O spiritual bird, praise God that at all times thou art mentioned before the All-Merciful and art present and appreciated in the hearts of the friends of God. Though outwardly thou art separated, in truth thou art circumambulating the Ka'bih of presence. The eye of God's loving-kindness hath ever been and is open toward that one who hath turned to God, and thou hast been and art observed through His infinite favors. Thou hast not been forgotten for a moment and never shalt be. Be assured of this by day and by night. His honor Aqa Muhammad-ʿAli is occupied with thy mention and all are beseeching and hoping from God that He may bestow such success that thou mayest attain to that which hath been the ultimate desire of thyself and all the friends of God. Convey to all the friends of God, both young and old, the Most Wondrous, Most Glorious greetings. And the spirit and glory be upon you.

## BH07950: O Siyyid-i-Baqir! Such afflictions have befallen the Wronged One… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Commanding, the All-Wise!

O Siyyid-i-Baqir! Such afflictions have befallen the Wronged One as have caused the lamentations of the lovers to ascend. We have been patient and concealed them. Verily thy Lord is the All-Patient. I do not complain of My grief and sorrow. I say what the ancients said when tribulation and adversity appeared. By God! The Glory dwelleth beneath affliction in the path of God, the Lord of the Sacred Monument and Station. When thou attainest unto My verses, say:

> "Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause, and the radiance of Thy Word, and the attraction of Thy verses, to make me steadfast and firm in Thy Cause and in Thy love. O my Lord! Thou seest the supplicant turning toward Thy Most Great Gate, and the seeker facing the direction of Thy bounty, O Lord of eternity! Ordain for him what befitteth Thy generosity, O Thou in Whose grasp is the reins of bounty! O my Lord! Deprive me not of the wonders of Thy grace. Ordain for me all the good Thou hast ordained in Thy Book. Verily Thou art the Compassionate, the Giving, the Forgiving, the Merciful."

## BH07856: He speaketh in the Kingdom of Utterance {.unnumbered}

He speaketh in the Kingdom of Utterance.

We bear witness that there is none other God but Him. His are the greatness and the majesty and the loftiness and the power and the bounty. He giveth whom He willeth what He willeth, and He is the Single One, the One, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having guided Thy servant unto Thy straight path and ordained for him that which drew him nigh unto Thee in days wherein the limbs of the idolaters trembled. Thou didst open unto him the gate of attainment to Thy presence and honored him with that which was recorded in Thy Books and Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets. Thou art, verily, the One Who hath power over whatsoever He pleaseth, and within Thy grasp are the reins of all that are in the heavens and on earth. I beseech Thee, O Lord of eternity and Creator of nations, by Thy Most Great Name, to make me successful in remembering Thee and praising Thee and serving Thy Cause. Then ordain for me the good of the world to come and of the first. Verily, Thou art the Lord of the Throne on high and of the dust below. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the Powerful.

## BH07895: O My Afnan, upon thee be My Glory! Thou… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing!

O My Afnan, upon thee be My Glory! Thou didst make mention without a tongue. Now doth the tongue of the All-Merciful make mention of thee on thy behalf—a mention that shall bestow upon all things a new tongue. Verily thy Lord, the All-Merciful, is the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

Although divine decree is irrevocable and outwardly may not accord with the desire of God's servants, in truth it is, to those possessed of insight, dearer than life itself. God's purpose in creation hath been bounty and grace. Assuredly He hath willed the good of all. Whatsoever may come to pass, be it tribulation or hardship, or ease and comfort, all transpireth according to the requirements of His consummate wisdom.

Such is His grace that, as thou seest, He speaketh in place of him who hath no tongue, and maketh mention of him—a mention that shall cause souls to be mindful throughout ages and centuries. Glory be upon thee, and upon him, and upon those who have cast away idle fancies, clinging fast to the cord of the commandments of their Lord, the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

## BH07503: O Rahim! Hearken unto what the Nightingale of Holiness… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty.

O Rahim! Hearken unto what the Nightingale of Holiness teacheth thee. Know thou that whatsoever We have desired or do desire for you is for your benefit. Cast therefore upon thyself the love of God, then remember that which He loveth and with which He is well-pleased. Keep thyself from self and be not neglectful in the Cause of God. Be in the utmost state of submission and contentment, and follow not thy desires but rather follow what this needy servant conveyeth unto thee, for he desireth for thee naught save what he desireth for himself, and teacheth thee not a letter except by that which he hath taught himself, and remembereth thee not save by that which he remembereth his own soul, and loveth thee now as he loved thee before. Beware lest thou grieve over anything or doubt in the Cause of God. Live in the world with joy and delight, then build thy affairs upon trust in God and contentment. And peace be upon thee and upon whomsoever followeth guidance.

## BH07912: O my handmaiden and leaf! Upon thee be My… {.unnumbered}

In the name of Him Who liveth and endureth forever.

O my handmaiden and leaf! Upon thee be My Glory and loving-kindness. Praise be to God that through divine favor and merciful grace thou hast entered the pavilion of heavenly knowledge and gained intimacy with one near to the threshold of the Lord of Oneness. Preserve this most great bounty and most glorious station in the name of the One Beloved. The whole world hath been created for the recognition of this wondrous Day, yet how many queens of the world are today deprived of the sealed wine of the Self-Subsisting Lord, while thou art among those who have attained unto it. Say:

Praise be unto Thee, O God of the worlds, for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and guided me to the horizon of Thy Revelation. I beseech Thee to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who circle round Thy throne and hold fast to the Tree of Thy bounty. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Powerful, the All-Bountiful. The splendor shining from the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon thee and upon those who have turned unto God and believed in God, the One, the All-Knowing.

## BH07798: Say: O my God, my God! I am Thy… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Inaccessible, the Most Holy, the Most Exalted, the Most Glorious

Say: O my God, my God! I am Thy handmaid and the daughter of Thy handmaid. I bear witness to Thy greatness and Thy sovereignty, to Thy might and Thy power, to Thy majesty and Thy glory. Verily, Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee. From everlasting Thou hast been supreme over Thy servants and Thy handmaids, and potent over all who are in Thy earth and in Thy heaven.

I beseech Thee by Thy mercy which hath preceded all created things, by Thy grace which hath encompassed all contingent beings, by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge, and by the splendours of Thy countenance, to make me, under all conditions, to turn wholly unto Thy most exalted Horizon, and to hold fast to the cord of Thy loving-kindness, O Thou Who art the Lord of names and the Creator of the heavens.

I implore Thee, moreover, to ordain for me the good of this world and of the world to come, and whatsoever befitteth the ocean of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy generosity, O Thou in Whose grasp are held the reins of gifts and bestowals. There is none other God but Thee, the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. Praise be to Thee, inasmuch as Thou art the Desire of them that have attained unto true knowledge.

## BH07456: The splendor shining forth from the heaven of My… {.unnumbered}

The splendor shining forth from the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon you and upon your son who was named Aqa Buzurg and your other son who was named Aqa Kuchik—upon those who have cast away their idle fancies and taken hold of that which they were commanded by God, the Lord of all beings and the Possessor of bounties and favors.

O thou who gazest upon the Countenance that hath turned toward the lights of the Throne, and who art engaged in remembrance and praise during the days of God, the Lord of all beings! Thy letter hath attained unto Our presence, and We have mentioned repeatedly those servants who heard and responded to their Lord, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Convey My greetings to each one on behalf of this Wronged One and illumine them with the splendorous lights of the Sun of divine utterance. His honor Salman, upon him be My glory, arrived and dwelt for some time beneath the shade, and when the appointed time of his sojourn came to an end, the command to return shone forth from the Dayspring of the Divine Will, and We sent with him that which would strengthen My loved ones, My trusted ones and My chosen ones who have remained firm in the Covenant and Testament.

The friends must not act except with wisdom. Wisdom is that through which the servants draw nigh, not that which causeth remoteness and flight. Verily thy Lord is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The glory be upon thee and upon those with thee, and We hear thy words concerning this Most Great Announcement.

## BH07539: Ancient lights course through the mighty Throne, and profound… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

Ancient lights course through the mighty Throne, and profound mysteries are inscribed upon fragrant tablets, and the Dove of Power soars in the holy atmosphere of might on wings of strength, and the Bird of Grandeur warbles new and wondrous melodies of exaltation, and the Peacock of the Paradise of Oneness utters its cry with holy eternality's might, and the birds of the sanctuary of glory circle in flight, and the maidens of beauty from the realm of eternity wave their hands, and the nightingale of the splendor of the mystery of faithfulness arranges itself in ranks.

Praise be to God that the King of power and might is seated upon the throne of glory, and the Sovereign of eternity is established in the realm of meeting, and the sweet-scented breezes of eternity are stirred from the left side of the Beloved's locks, and the fragrant musk of faithfulness wafts from the right side of the Intended One's hair, and the Bird of Light warbles upon the branches of the Tree of Sinai, and the Cock of Glorification sings in the gardens of Divine Unity.

Therefore praise be to God, the Beloved of the first and the last, the manifest and the hidden.

## BH07572: The verses have been revealed, the Book hath spoken… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

The verses have been revealed, the Book hath spoken, and the Promised One hath appeared; yet the peoples of the earth were withheld from the Most Exalted Horizon by the veils and doubts cast up by ignorant divines. The falsehood of their spoken words became a flame that kindled corruption among all men, and turned them all toward the infernal fire. They cried, "May God hasten His advent!"—and thereby hastened only their own descent into hell. Glorified be God! How pure deeds make manifest their effects—thus hath it been.

I beseech the True One to throw open before the faces of all the portal of His grace, and not to deprive His loved ones of the soft murmur of the Divine Lote-Tree, nor of the sealed wine, nor of the lights of the Presence of the Self-Subsisting. May they drink, and hear, and behold.

O Yusuf! Upon thee be the glory of God. We remembered thee before, and remember thee at this hour as well, and We exhort thee unto that whereby the Cause of God shall be exalted. Be eloquent in His praise, aflame with the fire of His love, and steadfast through His power. Verily, He is with thee. Give thanks unto thy Lord, the Mighty, the Subduing, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

## BH07587: Jinab-i-ʿAli Haydar—upon him be Baha'i glory and loving-kindness—is… {.unnumbered}

He is the Truth, the Knower of the unseen.

Jinab-i-ʿAli Haydar—upon him be Baha'i glory and loving-kindness—is, in truth, afflicted with great and manifold burdens, for the ordering and arrangement of the affairs of the flowers resteth with him. Great, indeed, is his recompense with God. The friends of God must beseech of the True One, glorified be His majesty, that He may preserve and protect him. Verily, He is the Hearer, the Answerer. They should moreover supplicate for him blessings, wealth, and power.

That which hath been mentioned concerning the claim of Aqa Muhammad-Baqir of Ardikan is in accordance with what is right. It should be paid with all promptness in the presence of Hadrat-i-ʿIlm, and, agreeably to what hath been set forth, a receipt should be sent.

O my God and the God of all the worlds! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name to open before the face of him who hath arisen to serve Thy Cause the door of Thy bounty and Thy grace; then guard him from Thine enemies. O Lord! Thou knowest that Baha desireth that Thy Name be exalted throughout the East and the West of the earth, through Thy Name and Thy sovereignty. Thou, verily, art the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

## BH07610: He abideth forever in the Kingdom {.unnumbered}

He abideth forever in the Kingdom.

Mention in the Book the Spirit [Jesus] whose name was exalted. He was born of His mother, then lived in the realm but a few days, and was taken up unto God in His younger years—a matter decreed in the Tablet. He left the earth when he caught the fragrance of mortality therefrom, and turned toward the heaven of holy immortality. Peace be upon Him the day He was born, and the day He was raised up, and the day He ascended to the sublime pavilion of glory. He remained in the world only so long as roses remain in springtime—when summer's heat came, His beauty was veiled behind an impalpable veil. His days were but as the days of roses—thus was it ordained by the hidden Pen of might. For this did every seeing eye weep in secret. God shall manifest Him beneath crimson canopies, in a station resplendent with truth. And the Spirit be upon Him and upon those who followed Him to the pure crimson land. 152

## BH07651: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the Preserver!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Beautiful Names, and Thy Most Perfect and Exalted Words, and by the lights of Thy Countenance in the heaven of eternity, and by Thy Most Great, Most Perfect, Most Generous Name, through which all faces have turned toward the face of Thy Self-Sufficiency, and all hearts have been made to drink the holy waters of Thy Oneness, and through which every poor one hath been enriched, and every abased one hath been exalted, and every sick one hath been healed—to preserve the bearer of this Tablet from every affliction and illness, and from every disease and malady, and from whatsoever may occur through Thy decree in Thy kingdom of plague and pestilence and less than these, from all that causeth souls to tremble and bodies and hearts to be disturbed. Verily, Thou art He Who doeth what He pleaseth through Thy power and ordaineth what He willeth through the sovereignty of Thy command. None can resist Thy decree in the kingdom of Thy might, and none can prevent the execution of Thy judgment in the heaven of Thy creation. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious, the Most Generous, the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

## BH07662: 4484137 He is the Comforter 137444 {.unnumbered}

4484137 He is the Comforter 137444

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I testify unto Thee in all things that Thou art God, there is no God but Thee. Thou hast ever been sanctified above the mention of all things and wilt ever continue to be as Thou hast been from before. There is no God but Thee, and unto Thee is the final return. I beseech Thee, O my God, by Thy Most Great Name, the All-Glorious, the Most Glorious, and by the Ultimate Tree, the Most Exalted, the All-Exalted, that Thou protect the bearer of this white leaf from all evil, calamity, plague and pestilence. Verily, Thou dost protect whom Thou willest, for Thou hast knowledge of all things.
